exterior.silhouette: One long crest rises from the bow, holds level over midships and drops to a lower aft terrace above a squared stern.
exterior.bow: A plumb bow with a fine entry; the crest begins just behind it.
exterior.hull: A Basalt Graphite gloss hull with a straight sheer and one row of hull windows at the gym.
exterior.superstructure: Five decks in Salt White step back under the crest; the bridge deck is the shortest and sits forward.
exterior.glazing: Smoke glazing in separate groups: two tall bow windows on the upper deck, recessed bow windows at the wheelhouse, slot windows at the sky lounge and full-height aft glazing at the salon.
exterior.mast_radar: No visible mast; radar domes sit flush in the crest roof behind the mirror facets.
exterior.stern: A squared transom above a full-width stern platform; the pool terrace sits one deck above it.
exterior.water_access: A full-width stern platform at the waterline, reached from the lower deck aft.

innovations.name: Crest Mirrors
innovations.purpose: Sends daylight down to the owner room below the crest.
innovations.position: Flush mirror facets along the crest roof.
innovations.geometry: Flat facets 2 by 3 m behind flush shields.
innovations.visible_expression: Rectangular mirror facets readable from above.
innovations.effect: A band of daylight crosses the owner room floor.

innovations.name: Sunken Pool
innovations.purpose: Lets guests swim below the wind line.
innovations.position: A pool recessed into the aft terrace.
innovations.geometry: A 9 m basin with a stepped edge.
innovations.visible_expression: The basin sits below the terrace edge.

innovations.name: Rib Ceiling
innovations.purpose: Carries the crest load without columns in the salon.
innovations.position: Curved ribs across the salon ceiling.
